subject: Welcome to the garage!
body:
Hi there, rookie!

I started Corner Movers in a garage too. It smelled like diesel and big dreams.

Unpack your boxes first. Put things wherever feels right.

Keep the shiny side up,
Mile Marker

subject: Nice placement
body:
Look at you, snapping things into place.

The whiteboard goes on the wall. Trust me, it'll fill up.

10-4,
Mile Marker

subject: The Market icon
body:
See the Market icon? Folks trade the oddest office goods there.

Buy low, sell when the line goes up. If it dips, wait it out, same as a traffic jam.

Over and out,
Mile Marker

subject: Your first profit!
body:
A sale! Write it on the whiteboard.

Okay, I already did. I log everything. Ask my logbook.

10-4,
Mile Marker

subject: Want to borrow the truck?
body:
Rather lift than trade? I've got a spare Corner Movers truck.

Pack it, strap it, drive it, unpack it. Bumps cost a little pay, but nothing ever breaks for good.

Check your load straps,
Mile Marker

First hundred! That's worth a doodle.

Treat yourself to a plant. Or a truck-stop coffee. I give the ones at Exit 12 four stars.

Mile Marker

subject: Halfway to the next exit
body:
$500 earned. The garage is starting to look like an office.

I logged it: 'Rookie doing great.' It's official now.

Over and out,
Mile Marker

subject: I saw a listing...
body:
$1,500 and three jobs done. Check Office Listings.

There's a Shared Coworking spot with an actual window. Not a garage door. A window.

Shiny side up,
Mile Marker

subject: Moving Whisker & Bean
body:
Hi! Mile Marker says you're careful.

Our cafe is moving two streets over. Mugs are fragile. Biscuit is... curious.

Coffee on the house,
Priya

subject: A delicate matter
body:
Good afternoon.

I'm moving to a smaller flat with my clocks. All 41. They prefer to travel upright.

With thanks,
D. Finch

subject: help?? moving sat
body:
hey!! new flat, same amps. also 14 plants.

the drum kit is mostly in pieces already lol

- juno

subject: Shop move (we disagree on everything)
body:
Rosa: We're merging our flower shops.
Ray: Rosa is merging into MY shop.
Both: Please bring extra boxes.

subject: Thank you!!
body:
Everything arrived! And thank you for finding Biscuit.

He's asleep in the new menu board. My friend Mr. Finch needs movers. I gave him your name.

- Priya

subject: All 41 ticking
body:
Every clock is ticking. Even Gerald, who usually sulks after a move.

Please accept a small tip. Also my eternal respect.

- D. Finch

subject: ur a legend
body:
plants alive. amps alive. me alive.

you're invited to our next gig. it's in a laundromat.

- juno
